title: Chlädderi mappack
description: One climbing region for the Chlädderi app: crags («Gebiete»), their routes, the car parks, the area groups and the little bit of metadata the app needs to show the region. A mappack can be loaded into the app and unloaded again. Unknown properties are allowed on purpose: an older app ignores fields it does not know.

id.description: Identity of the pack and the region key the app stores on every crag (s.reg). Installing a pack replaces an installed pack with the same id.

name.description: Short label for the region switcher, two or three words at most.

fullName.description: Long name for headings, where the short label would be too terse.

version.description: Version of the pack data, e.g. a date «2026-10-10». Shown in the pack list and compared when a pack is re-installed.

partial.description: true for a sample or showcase pack that only holds a few crags. The app then keeps asking for a full pack.

ch.description: Region in Switzerland: swisstopo base map and trails, MeteoSchweiz forecast, approach planner on swisstopo paths.

text.description: The words that belong to this region: the app itself knows none of them.

view.description: Where the map opens for this region.

bbox.description: [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] over all located crags and car parks.

counts.description: What the pack holds, so the pack list can say it without parsing everything.

areas.description: Area groups («Zonen») that the crags of this pack belong to. Every sector.area must appear here.

parks.description: Car parks, keyed by the id used in sector.pk, sector.pkOff and sector.ap[].pk.

sectors.description: The crags. One entry is one «Gebiet» of the atlas.

picSrc.description: Names of the picture sources. A picture refers to its source by index into this list; the app renumbers the indices when it loads the pack.

labels.description: Place names drawn on the map where the base map has none.

outline.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection drawn under the tiles (municipality shapes with a «name» property are labelled).

stats.description: Coverage numbers of the region, free-form. The app computes what it shows on the coverage page itself; these travel with the pack as its own record.

de.description: German for short English strings in the data (rock names, source notes) that have no «…De» twin.

notes.description: A sentence about the pack, shown while it is being installed.

text.description: Everything the app would otherwise have to know about a region: how its rock is called, which guidebook covers it, the pages it adds under «More», its fun facts and its glossary. All of it is optional; what a pack leaves out, the app leaves out.

rock.description: How the rock is named on every crag page of this region. Without it each crag's own «rock» field is used.

guide.description: One line under the links of a crag page, e.g. which guidebook holds the complete topos. When the pack also brings a page with the id «topos», the line links to it.

noPics.description: Shown instead of the gallery when the pack carries no pictures at all.

guideRef.description: Sentence around a crag's «guide» field (its place in a printed guidebook). {0} is replaced by that field.

licence.description: Where the data of this region comes from and under which licence. Shown under «About» next to the app's own notice.

links.description: What the links of a crag are called, keyed like sector.links (plus «tc» for the area link). Without an entry the app falls back to a neutral label.

label.description: What the link offers, e.g. «Photo topo».

note.description: The quiet line under it, usually the source and whether it is free.

pages.description: Pages this region adds under «More → About the data».

facts.description: Fun facts, shown on the «Worth knowing» page in the order given here.

groups.description: Headings for the facts. A fact without a group, or with one that is not listed, comes last without a heading.

go.description: [crag name, route name]: the app offers a link into the atlas when it finds that route.

glossary.description: Words a climber meets in the topos and on the signs of this region.

lang.description: Language tag of the terms, e.g. «it», so that screen readers pronounce them.

page.description: One page of running text. Blocks are shown in the order given.

id.description: «topos» is linked from the crag pages; any other id only appears under «More».

block.description: Exactly one of h (heading), p (paragraph), hint (quiet paragraph) or ul (list). In the text, **bold** and [label](https://…) are understood; everything else is shown as written.

n.description: Number of crags in this area group.

reg.description: Ignored on load: the app stamps the pack id.

est.description: true: the position is estimated, not taken from a source.

n.description: Number of crags served by this car park.

route.description: [name, grade, pitches, grade index into the app's grade list]. The app adds further entries at runtime (key, stars, length, place in the list).

prefixItems.description: Pitches. 0 (or null) where no source says how many; the app then says nothing about pitches.
Place in the app's grade list, or null for a grade it does not know.

precision.description: pin: from a source · approx: roughly placed · anchor: the wall is not located, the marker stands by the car park.

approach.description: A walk from a car park to the wall, as computed by the data tooling.

gap.description: Metres without a path at the end.

alt.description: true: an alternative, not the main approach.

pic.description: [url, altUrl (0 = none), page url, picSrc index, kind, whole-crag flag, caption (0 = none), author (0 = none), licence (0 = none), content]

sector.description: One crag. Only the keys the app really needs are required; everything else is optional and may be null.

id.description: Stable id; part of the route keys in the logbook and of the link in the address bar. Never change it.

area.description: Area group; must be one of the pack's areas.

full.description: Area and name in one line.

reg.description: Ignored on load: the app stamps the pack id.

alt.description: Height of the wall in m, where a source gives it.

nRoutes.description: Routes the sources count, which can be more than the list holds.

bands.description: Routes per grade band, same bands as the app's bar chart.

rk.description: Route keys a route had before the list was reordered, so favourites and logbook stay attached.

rl.description: Length per route in m, parallel to routes.

st.description: Community stars per route: [stars, number of ratings].

ord.description: Where the order of the route list comes from. Absent: the order at the wall is unknown.

secs.description: Walls inside the crag: name and the index of its first route.

len.description: Route lengths of the crag in m: [shortest, longest].

rain.description: yes: a source calls the crag rainproof.

dryHow.description: est: estimated from sun and aspect · src: a source says so.

bolt.description: Bolting, only where a source says it outright.

q.description: The wording: [route or empty, English, German].

pkOff.description: Car park the official source names, when it differs.

park.description: Car park in the words of the source.

walk.description: Approach in the words of the source.

walkMin.description: Walking time in minutes from the source.

walkEff.description: Walking time the app sorts and filters by.

warn.description: Closures and cautions in the words of the source; the app reads it for the closure and caution marks.

rnote.description: Note about the route list, e.g. that only part of it is known.

guide.description: Place in the printed guide, e.g. «Nr. 12, S. 64».

tc.description: What an outside route database holds for this crag: its name there, the number of routes and the height.

links.description: Links: t/c topo and crag pages, o official, f photos, g gallery, l list, p pdf, r route list, w further web pages.
